description: This file defines an exception mapper for AccessDeniedException within the Fineract platform. Its purpose is to convert AccessDeniedExceptions into HTTP 403 Forbidden responses in a REST API context, providing a JSON error response.

classes.name: AccessDeniedExceptionMapper
classes.description: This class implements ExceptionMapper to handle AccessDeniedException and convert it into a standardized API error response with HTTP status 403.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an AccessDeniedException into a JSON API response with a 403 status, including an error message derived from the exception.
